entities.summary: Alejandro Alberto De Aza Ceda is a Dominican professional baseball outfielder for the Southern Maryland Blue Crabs of Atlantic League of Professional Baseball. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Florida Marlins, Chicago White Sox, Baltimore Orioles, Boston Red Sox, San Francisco Giants, New York Mets, and Washington Nationals.
